title: Build-review verdict record
description: One build review of one phase (REQ-030 R05, PLAN-047 D4): one file under docs/08-governance/reviews/verdicts/, named <verdict_id>.json. The coordinator writes it from the reviewer's reply without changing a finding and hands it to the builder, who commits it unchanged on the phase branch. Every field except outcomes is fixed once committed; outcomes are appended later, oldest first, as GOV-018 records append dispositions. The re-review sampler's draw record, one file per draw under docs/08-governance/reviews/draws/, is definitions/draw below.

verdict_id.description: The file's name without .json: the review date, the phase id, then the reviewer type, for example 2026-10-02-phase-asr-03-demo-adversary. A second review of the same phase by the same type on the same day adds a counter: ...-demo-adversary-2.

reviewed_commit.description: The full commit the review judged: the commit the command runner (tools/run_review_checks.py) ran at.

definition_sha256.description: sha256 of the agent definition file (.claude/agents/<type>.md) the reviewer was dispatched with, so a later change to the definition is visible against the verdicts it produced.

model.description: The model the reviewer ran on, as the dispatch reported it. Required: recording it is the precondition for cross-model review (REQ-030, What each requirement is not).

verdict.description: pass=the reviewer found the phase may merge, with or without findings | reject=it found the phase may not merge as it stands.

gating.description: true=this verdict decided the merge | false=it ran in shadow and decided nothing (REQ-030 R06). A sampled re-review is recorded with false: the merge it would have decided has already happened.

findings.description: Every finding in the reviewer's reply, as the reviewer wrote it. Empty when it found nothing.

raw_reply_sha256.description: sha256 of the reviewer's raw reply, which the coordinator keeps as an evidence file (PLAN-047 D4).

outcomes.description: What was learned about the verdict afterwards, oldest first. Empty when the record is written; entries are only ever appended.

notes.description: Anything a reader needs about how this review was run. Optional.

reviewer_type.description: The dedicated reviewer's agent type, for example demo-adversary or review-judge.

id.description: The finding's id, unique within its record: F01, F02 and so on.

evidence.description: What the reviewer checked to establish the defect: an evidence file from the runner's manifest, or a file and line quoted.

condition.description: The scope, acceptance or verification entry the finding is about, quoted. Optional.

minimal_fix.description: The smallest change that would resolve the finding, named rather than written. Optional.

kind.description: owner-overturned=the owner decided against the verdict at G4 or G5 | defect-found-on-dev=a defect this review passed was later found on dev | sampled-rereview=the sampler drew the phase and another reviewer type re-reviewed it (REQ-030 R07).

recorded_by.description: Who appended the outcome: an agent id or repository-owner.

detail.description: What happened: the owner's words, the defect and where it was found, or the re-review's result in one sentence.

draw_id.description: The draw that sampled the phase. Required for sampled-rereview.

reviewer_type.description: The type that did the re-review. Required for sampled-rereview; never a type the draw excluded.

verdict.description: The re-review's verdict. Required for sampled-rereview.

verdict_id.description: The re-review's own verdict record, when one was written. Optional.

draw.title: Re-review draw record
draw.description: One run of tools/draw_rereview_sample.py (REQ-030 R07, PLAN-047 D6): one file under docs/08-governance/reviews/draws/, named <draw_id>.json. Lists every gating verdict the draw considered, so the next draw starts after them, and the seed, so anyone can re-run the draw and get the same sample.

draw_id.description: The file's name without .json: the draw date and a two-digit counter for that date, from 01.

seed.description: The seed the one-in-ten draw used.

rate.description: One in this many passed gating reviews is drawn, rounded up.

considered.description: The verdict_id of every gating verdict this draw read, sorted. No later draw reads them again.

verdict_id.description: The passing gating verdict that was drawn; the re-review's outcome is appended to this record.

reason.description: one-in-ten=drawn by the seed | rejected-before-pass=a gating review rejected the phase before one passed it, so it is always drawn.

excluded_reviewer_types.description: Every reviewer type with a verdict record for the phase, gating or shadow. None of them may re-review it.
